title: HPE security advisory (AV26-1079)
description: As of October 22, 2026, Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) is affected by vulnerabilities in the following product:
products:
HPE Networking Wireless Operating Systems - AOS
	Versions prior to 10.8.1.2
Versions prior to 10.7.2.7
Versions prior to 10.4.1.14
Versions prior to 8.13.3.1
Versions prior to 8.10.0.24
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
